text:
Maria (eng-sre): Heads-up — nightly embedder job in eu-west1 is spiking Xid 31 on A10 nodes since ~01:00 UTC, roughly 3x baseline. P50s fine but tails are noisy. Anyone else seeing this? link: https://telemetry.internal/q/abc

Anand (infra): Pulling metrics now, will post top nodes.

ops-bot: telemetry query finished — returning 18 matches, top nodes: gpu-03-uw1, gpu-09-uw1, gpu-11-uw1.

Zoe (runtime): Nightly embedder uses seq_len=2048, batch=64, kv-cache disabled, streaming disabled. Could be large contiguous allocations.

Maria (eng-sre): ECC counters incrementing on gpu-03-uw1 around the same time as Xid31 spikes. Not massive but consistent.

Priya (oncall): Can you paste node IDs + current ECC counts? If a node >3 Xid31/hr I'll mark for drain.

Maria (eng-sre): gpu-03-uw1 (Xid31=7 in last 2h, corrected_ecc=412), gpu-09-uw1 (Xid31=4, corrected_ecc=120), gpu-11-uw1 (Xid31=2, corrected_ecc=40).

Tom (hwops): Which driver/firmware? ECC + Xid can point to bad memory or firmware.

Anand (infra): Fleet driver: 515.65; firmware on flagged A10s shows 51.0.60 on gpu-03-uw1 (slightly older). Kernel logs include: "Xid 31: P4" and scattered "gpu watchdog" entries.

Zoe (runtime): Hypothesis: large batch-size + long seq causing repeated page/fence churn. Embedder alloc pattern is many medium-size contiguous buffers which may stress allocator on A10.

Maria (eng-sre): Quick telemetry query I ran:
```
curl -s 'https://telemetry.internal/api/query' -d '{
  "metric":"nv.xid",
  "filter":{"code":"31","region":"eu-west1","gpu_type":"A10"},
  "from":"2024-11-27T00:00:00Z","to":"2024-11-27T02:00:00Z"
}'
```
Results show ~90% of Xid31 events tied to tenant "vec-embed" during nightly index window.

Anand (infra): I joined tenants -> nodes -> job config: 88% from vec-embed job with batch=64. Correlation matrix indicates batch size and request concurrency are the strongest signals.

Tom (hwops): Plan suggestion: reduce batch to 32 for canary, enable early drain if node records >=4 Xid31 in 1h, queue hardware memtest for nodes that continue to spike. If ECC corrected counts keep rising, mark for replace.

Priya (oncall): I'm patching the vec-embed job to batch=32 on a canary subset in eu-west1 now. Will also add alert: nv.xid31_rate_per_node > 0.02 for 5m -> pager.

deploy-bot: config updated for service=vec-embed {"batch_size":32} — canary rolling to 10% of traffic.

Maria (eng-sre): Also please correlate inlet temp / power draw for affected racks — A10s in rack 7b had inlet spike ~00:40 UTC. Could be related.

Anand (infra): Got ambient/power logs: small temp uptick of ~2C during window; not dramatic but coincides with mount of nightly indexing across many tenants.

Zoe (runtime): If mitigation (batch=32) reduces Xid31 rate, we can opt to keep it overnight and schedule full fleet update later. If not, escalate to vendor with kernel+driver traces.

Tom (hwops): I'll schedule memtest and extended burn on gpu-03-uw1 and gpu-09-uw1 tonight. If tests show bitflips or unrecoverable ECC, we'll take RMA.

Priya (oncall): Marking nodes for soft-drain threshold=4 Xid31/h. I'll follow up with incident ticket if any node exceeds while canary is live.

Maria (eng-sre): Thanks all. Action items: 1) canary reduce batch -> Priya, 2) memtest + hardware triage -> Tom, 3) driver/firmware audit -> Anand, 4) follow-up alert + report in morning -> Maria.

Anand (infra): I'll also run a cohort analysis to check whether embedder code path touches large host pinned buffers or uses cudaHostAlloc frequently — that pattern showed up in past Xid31 cases.

deploy-bot: canary shows initial 10% with batch=32 — no Xid31s in first 12 min (monitoring: green).

Maria (eng-sre): Nice. If green for 30m we can expand to 50% and keep overnight.

Tom (hwops): HW note: if firmware mismatch found, coordinate maintenance window — will need node reboot.

Priya (oncall): I'll post a morning summary in #eng-sre with numbers and decide on replace/drain. :thumbsup:

Maria (eng-sre): Great. Thanks everyone.
